power.neoorigins.kraken_deep_current.des: Sṭerḥbet akteṛ n yal imezdaɣ n ddunit.
power.neoorigins.kraken_pressure_armor.d: Ɣuṛ-iyi-d ṭṭmeɛ iwakken ad ffɣeɣ lebḥeṛ lqayen, yebnan iwakken ad țwaḥeqṛeɣ.
power.neoorigins.kraken_regen_in_water.d: Sbedd-ed 2 HP mkul senniḍen di waman.
power.neoorigins.kraken_beached.name: Urrif
power.neoorigins.kraken_beached.descript: Tețțawi-d 30% ițzuxxu deg wakal, ur yebni ara iwakken ad ileḥḥu.
M'ara d-yaweḍ yiwet n lexsaṛa m'ara d-yaweḍ yiṭij.
?erreḥ-ed aɛessas iwakken ad imenɛen fell-awen. Mačči n 2 di teswiɛt. Llan cinq n leḥwayeǧ. 20-es senniḍen tețwaḥesbeḍ yiwen n lexsaṛa ma yemmut di ṭṭmeɛ.
power.neoorigins.kraken_massive.name: Collossal
power.neoorigins.kraken_dries_out.name: Rrif dinna
power.neoorigins.kraken_dries_out.descri: Mazal-ikkun tesɛam seg waman, aṭas n waman, aṭas n waman i d-tekkam. Ițwaɣeḍ, d aman, d aman, d aman, neɣ d aqṛuc n waman i gzedɣen, ṭṭfen-t kullec.
power.neoorigins.abyssal_summon_guardian: ?erreḥ-ed aɛessas iwakken ad imenɛen fell-awen. Mačči n 2 di teswiɛt. Llan cinq n leḥwayeǧ. 20-es senniḍen tețwaḥesbeḍ yiwen n lexsaṛa ma yemmut di ṭṭmeɛ.
origins.neoorigins.warden.name: Warden
origins.neoorigins.warden.description: Seg ṭṭlam n ṭṭlam, ddunit-agi yesɛan lḥebs s ṭṭmeɛ, yessers-ed aɛeqqa n ddnub, yeɣli-d am yiwet n wergaz iḥekkmen, yesɛan leḥzen akk-d yiṭij.
power.neoorigins.warden_sonic_boom.name: ?buq Sonic
power.neoorigins.warden_sonic_boom.descr: Tmes a d-yesseɣli tameqqrant (8 tnezmert + ṭṭmeɛ n lǧețțat nniḍen di tmura n ɛecṛa-nni). Ɛeddan ṛebɛa tazmert, 20-es seǧǧi.
power.neoorigins.warden_echolocation.des: mkul amkan i deg ara d-yedṛun, țwalint ula d leɛṛuṛ.
power.neoorigins.warden_tremor_sense.des: mkul tnac sennig, kullec yesɛan tfeǧǧiǧ di tlata senniḍen.
power.neoorigins.warden_strength.name: Lǧehd ṭṭlam
power.neoorigins.warden_strength.descrip: A d-yefk ṛebɛa lexṣaṣ i deg ara d-yefk deg-s.
power.neoorigins.warden_ancient_hide.des: Lǧețțat-nni i d-iqqimen lǧețța n Sidi Ṛebbi, d lǧețța n ṭṭmeɛ akk-d ṭṭmeɛ n ṭṭmeɛ, ur d-yețțili ara aṭas n cceṛ.
M'ara d-yaweḍ yiwet n lexsaṛa m'ara d-yaweḍ yiṭij.
power.neoorigins.warden_lumbering.name: Aẓekkaz
power.neoorigins.warden_lumbering.descri: Tețzuxxu 30% yesɛan azal akteṛ n tuccḍa — tazmert ițțunefken meɛna yesɛan tazmert.
origins.neoorigins.dwarf.name: Dwarf
origins.neoorigins.dwarf.description: Yiwen ixeddamen n lqaɛa, yesɛan lḥekma, yesɛan lḥekma yerna yesɛan azal, lameɛna yesɛan azal, yesɛan azal.
power.neoorigins.dwarf_compact_frame.des: 80% tameqqrant n aɛekkaz iɛeǧben — tḥemmlen s lǧiha mbla lmeɛna.
power.neoorigins.dwarf_stout_constitutio: Ur țțaggadeɣ ara di dayem, ur d-fkeɣ ara lmeṣnuɛ akk-d yiɣil.
power.neoorigins.dwarf_darkvision.name: ṭṭlam
power.neoorigins.dwarf_darkvision.descri: Tzemrem aț-țeẓrem di ṭṭlam yelhan, di ddunit meṛṛa.
power.neoorigins.dwarf_sturdy_legs.name: Iḍaṛṛen n leḥzen
power.neoorigins.dwarf_stonecunning.name: Adɣaɣ
power.neoorigins.dwarf_stonecunning.desc: Ɣef wannect-agi, sɛan azal n ddnub 25% ifeṛḥen ifassen ɣef yal idrimen.
power.neoorigins.dwarf_short_reach.name: Illawen kuten
power.neoorigins.dwarf_short_reach.descr: Lemfaṣel n tnefsit n ddnub ț-țamecṭuḥt s 0.5 — iqeddacen iɣes, iḍuɛen iǧehden.
power.neoorigins.dwarf_mining_hunger.des: Lecɣal yesɛan 25% mačči d laẓ i gebnan i ṣṣbeṛ.
Axaṭer m'ara textaṛeḍ ayagi, m'ara textaṛeḍ yiwet n tbuciḍant n tbuciḍant ( tikkelt tikkelt tikkelt tis snat n lfayda).
origins.neoorigins.breeze.name: Breeze
origins.neoorigins.breeze.description: Ayen i d-yelken waḍu i d-ilulen deg wexxam n ccṛeɛ, d uẓummu, d lebḥeṛ i d-yewwin, yesseɣli-d s ṭṭmeɛ, ma d tafat akk-d ṭṭmeɛ.
power.neoorigins.breeze_wind_charge.name: Lameṛ n waḍu
power.neoorigins.breeze_wind_charge.desc: A d-yaweḍ waḍu i d-ițțak iɛdawen nniḍen. 5-es senniḍen isseḥmu.
power.neoorigins.breeze_wind_dash.name: Aḍu-nni
power.neoorigins.breeze_wind_dash.descri: ?ef waḍu, ṛebɛa snat n tmeddit ḥemmlen.
power.neoorigins.breeze_no_fall_damage.d: Tazmert aț-țebɣiḍ aț-țbecciṛeḍ : waḍu i k-iṭṭef m'ara tɣelḍeḍ. M'ara teɣliḍ, tɛeggiḍ-ed aqcic-nni iwakken aț-țesɛuḍ ddnub ɛinani.
power.neoorigins.breeze_jump_boost.name: Ilfan
power.neoorigins.breeze_jump_boost.descr: Tzemrem aț-țesɛuḍ tikli-inek : tebɣiḍ aț-țesɛuḍ ṭṭmeɛ iɛelleq-ik (Jump Boost II). Axaṭer-iț, tḥekkṛeḍ s wacu i tebɣiḍ aț-țesɛuḍ ṭṭmeɛ.
power.neoorigins.breeze_speed_boost.name: Taylit
power.neoorigins.breeze_speed_boost.desc: ?ef waḍu i k-id-ițțak tazmert i deg tesɛiḍ 15%.
power.neoorigins.breeze_reduced_health.d: - ṛebɛa ulawen (-8 tameqqrant HP). Lǧețța n waḍu ur d-tețțawi ara lǧețța.
power.neoorigins.breeze_light_frame.name: Frameɣṛum fat
power.neoorigins.breeze_light_frame.desc: 90% tameqqrant n wacɣal ameqqran — tafat akk-d leǧwahi.
origins.neoorigins.vampire.name: Wampara
origins.neoorigins.vampire.description: Iḍ d aɛekkaz ur yemmut ara, ițɛicin, iǧehden, iǧehden, iǧehden, iwakken ad lluẓen i dayem.
power.neoorigins.vampire_entity_group.de: Sklassifikt am ur nemmut ara. Leḥmala n Instant, isseḥla s Instant ddnub, i gețwaxelqen si lǧiha n ddnub.
power.neoorigins.vampire_water_breathing: Ur ilaq ara ad yesɛu Ṛṛuḥ iqedsen, ur ilaq ara ad ițțunefken i dayem ɣef waman.
power.neoorigins.vampire_night_vision.de: Tzemrem aț-țeẓrem di ṭṭlam. Tbeggiḍ-ed aț-țfeǧǧiǧ deg aqcic n wawal n yiḍ (imezwura K).
power.neoorigins.vampire_attack_bonus.de: Yefka-d snat n lexṣaṣ i deg ara d-yefk deg-s.
power.neoorigins.vampire_speed_boost.des: Tețfeǧǧiǧ 15% ifeṛṛeḥ, d acemma di tafat n waggur.
power.neoorigins.vampire_daylight_damage: Tmes teṭṭfem, teṭṭfem snat n lexṣaṣ mkul sennig deg yiṭij.
power.neoorigins.vampire_slow_regen.name: Ɣef wayen yeɛnan leḥnana
power.neoorigins.vampire_slow_regen.desc: Tazmert n ṣṣifa n ṣṣifa tzemreḍ aț-țesɛedda d 40 % n tnefsit.
power.neoorigins.vampire_food_restrictio: Ur yezmir ara ad ččen kan lqut, lǧețța akkin d allen n tiṭwin.
power.neoorigins.vampire_blood_diet_bonu: Lǧețța-s n ṣṣifa yeṣfan i kkun-ițțakren am akken i kkun-iɛeǧben.
Mkul sennig, mkul aman neɣ m'ara d-yawi waman.
origins.neoorigins.monster_tamer.name: Tamer tamurt
origins.neoorigins.monster_tamer.descrip: Yiwet n leɛqiṛa ițțuɛaqben s lebɣi-nsen, ț-țaǧǧaǧat-nsen d iɛdawen i gețwaḥesben, meɛna s yiman-nsen, ț-țazmert ad țțuḥasben.
power.neoorigins.tamer_tame_mob.name: ?eqqṛet
power.neoorigins.tamer_tame_mob.descript: Walit i lɣaci iɛewdiwen-ik, tṣebṛeḍ-iț iwakken aț-țesɛuḍ lebɣi-k ; a k-t-id-tebɛeḍ, a k-ḥekkmen. Majmaɛt n ṛebɛa ṭṭmeɛ-iten argaz-agi.
power.neoorigins.tamer_command_pack.name: Sizmir ?
power.neoorigins.tamer_command_pack.desc: Walit lḥebs-agi, tṣebṛeḍ iwakken aț-țweṣṣiḍ kullec iwakken aț-țseǧǧeḍ.
power.neoorigins.tamer_horde_regen.name: Meyyat n ddnub
power.neoorigins.tamer_horde_regen.descr: Lɣaci-inek i tezmert a ten-yefk ṣṣbeṛ 1 HP mkul sețța senniḍen m'ara d-yefk umenɣi n umenɣi.
power.neoorigins.tamer_weak_alone.name: Ur nesɛi lǧehd
power.neoorigins.tamer_weak_alone.descri: Acḥal yesɛan 25% nniḍen i tesɛiḍ cceṛ ; sɛiḍ aț-țnaɣeḍ deg uḥebbuḍ-ik.
power.neoorigins.tamer_hunger_drain.name: Els-ed lfakya n tektabt

power.neoorigins.tame_mob.not_hostile: Ur zmiren ara kan ad ṭṭfen imdanen iɛewdiwen !
power.neoorigins.tame_mob.boss: Ur zmiren ara ad ṭṭfen imdanen !

power.neoorigins.command_pack.no_target: Ur d-yețwalin ara ayen i d-yețwali.
origins.neoorigins.earth_mage.name: Leɛmeṛ n ddunit

?ef wannect-agi lqaɛa, ḥemmlen-d sețța lexṛif, ḥemmlent-ed imdanen meṛṛa i gzedɣen.
power.neoorigins.earth_mage_stone_wall.d: Sserreḥ-ed aberriḥ n azṛu anda tețmuquleḍ.

power.neoorigins.earth_mage_rooted.descr: ?ṭef amkan n 50% imeẓẓuɣen ; m'ara s-d-yawi ṭṭmeɛ am wass.
power.neoorigins.earth_mage_heavy.name: yeẓẓuɣ
power.neoorigins.earth_mage_heavy.descri: Ur tezmirem ara aț-țesseɣliḍ am wedɣaɣ.
power.neoorigins.earth_mage_earthbound.d: Aql-iyi 50% nniḍen yeɣli-d cceṛ, lqaɛa a d-yefk ddnub-is.
